How do you intend to oust? unblockable bleeds

How do you intend to keep from being ousted? bloat with villein/restoration, intercept

What do you want your ready region to look like (ie, how many guys are you planning on getting out)? Una and two others maybe. Haven't played it yet

What do you want your average turn to look like? At least 1 unblockable bleed, followed by movement of the slow body and rapid healing. Restoration or bleed.

The ideal turn: Villein on Una. Una plays restoration (gains 3 blood). Una plays force of will (free), and day operation (free). Una goes to torpor. Una plays movement of the slow body (gains 1 blood) and rapid healing (gains 1 blood).

What's your metagame like? How do your opponents play? All kinds of decks. Little politics at the moment. A lot of intercept.

Messages.Author: technobabble66
Messages.Body:
FWIW, i've played a vaguely similar deck (esp different crypt). It works well until u sit next to someone w +1 intercept to block ur exit from torpor, or +3 intercept for the 4 occasions you can play Earth Control. Or next to a prey w bounce.

I luv the idea, but i couldn't get it to work satisfactorily

Loki's gift might help
Maybe put Humanitas & Catacombs onto one of the other minions, & use them to rescue first. If that gets blocked, you can try to have Una rescue herself, maybe

Maybe use Two Wrongs & Narrow Minds to discourage the bouncers.

Hope that helps!!
